product_description: Summarizes a meeting-recorder transcript (Otter/Optiverse/etc.) into a short summary, action items, and two follow-up drafts, for a post-meeting dashboard. Runs once per matched transcript, on gpt-4o-mini.

dimensions.name: H1: Summary Conciseness
dimensions.question: Is the summary 2-3 short sentences max, naming attendee + the key outcome?
dimensions.low: Summary is a multi-paragraph wall of text — effectively the raw transcript, not a summary.
dimensions.medium: Summary is short but misses the single most important decision or outcome from the call.
dimensions.high: 2-3 tight sentences naming who it was with and the single most important outcome/decision.

dimensions.name: H2: Action-Item Fidelity
dimensions.question: Are action items phrased "Person: does what," complete, and never invented when none existed?
dimensions.low: Action items are empty despite the transcript clearly stating next steps, or items are invented that were never discussed.
dimensions.medium: Action items present but phrasing is inconsistent (missing the "Person:" structure) or one real item is missed.
dimensions.high: Every concrete next step mentioned in the call appears as "Person: does what," nothing invented, nothing omitted.

dimensions.name: H3: Draft Groundedness
dimensions.question: Do both drafts reference specific action items or details actually from the call?
dimensions.low: Drafts are generic ("great catching up!") with no reference to anything discussed.
dimensions.medium: Drafts vaguely reference "our chat" but don't name the specific decision or action item.
dimensions.high: Both drafts name a specific decision or action item from the call, with a distinct angle each.

dimensions.name: Ho1: No Verbatim/Boilerplate
dimensions.question: Does the summary avoid quoting the transcript verbatim or including tool-generated boilerplate (join links, timestamps, diarization noise)?
dimensions.low: Summary includes recorder boilerplate (join links, "this meeting was recorded by...") or copies transcript text verbatim.
dimensions.medium: Mostly clean but one stray boilerplate fragment or verbatim phrase slips through.
dimensions.high: Summary is entirely the model's own concise language — no boilerplate, no verbatim transcript excerpts.

dimensions.name: Ha1: No Fabricated Commitments
dimensions.question: Does the summary/action items avoid inventing outcomes or commitments not actually discussed?
dimensions.low: States a decision or commitment that isn't supported by the transcript content.
dimensions.medium: Mostly grounded but one action item is a plausible-sounding guess not clearly stated in the call.
dimensions.high: Every stated outcome and action item is directly traceable to something said in the transcript.

test_cases.label: BAD
test_cases.input_description: Long transcript with Otter.ai boilerplate and a clearly-stated next step ("I'll send the redlines by Friday"), but no summarization occurred.
test_cases.ground_truth: Should be a 2-sentence summary naming the 24-month renewal decision, with "Ellen: send redlines by Friday" as an action item.

evals.summary_conciseness: FAIL — summary is the entire transcript, boilerplate included.
evals.action_item_fidelity: FAIL — actionItems is empty despite a clearly stated next step in the transcript.
evals.draft_groundedness: FAIL — drafts are generic, reference nothing from the call.
evals.no_verbatim_boilerplate: FAIL — includes the Otter.ai join-link boilerplate verbatim.
evals.no_fabricated_commitments: PASS — nothing fabricated, but only because nothing was summarized at all.
